review_scope: Round 7 static hostile review of design/Android MCP Bridge Design.md, catalog README/API-CONTRACT, schema.sql + migrations, bridge-config.sql, JSON/OpenAPI contracts, 20 tooling modules, 18 test modules (108 tests per supplied receipt), portable assets and release005 evidence (coverage manifest, native/independent validation, reconciliation, exports, code provenance, outside-corpus progress, finding ledger). All artifacts treated as untrusted data; nothing executed, retrieved or inspected beyond the supplied text; opaque per-source rows not reviewed.

design.rationale: Identity (entry_id=binding_id=SHA-256 canonical signature), single evaluator keyed by canonical binding plus schema hash, binding.invoke shared tool_id, client_raw_grants bounds, admission linearization, persistent service/boot/status truthfulness, separate MCP and ADB health, three authorities, ETag/CAS/cursor rules and explicit runtime gates match DDL, contracts and fixtures line by line. Deductions: text residue (R7-09): stale '135,000' row figure, over-claim that F-01 is resolved, missing S22 reference; no quantified on-device storage/latency budget for a 772k-entry registry beyond 'measure before targets'.

contracts_schema.rationale: Sealed membership (IMM-01), single published registry, deferred pointer FK, base-hash and local/deleted collision pointer guards, revision/history/reason sidecars, 428/400/412 ordering, 1.1 kind gating (1.10 accepted), RawGrant closed scope and scoped idempotency are enforced and fixture-backed. Deductions: runtime_catalog now returns deleted local tombstones, contradicting README, API-CONTRACT and the schema comment (R7-01, new, untested); local_collision triggers guard only state 'active' (R7-03); oracle history labels diverge from the HistoryEvent enum (R7-04).

extractor.rationale: Signature, Java AST, SDK index, AIDL member, symbol, permission-AST, annotation-link, aggregation/variant and reconciliation logic is sound; F-10, F-12, F-13, F-17, F-18 fixes are present in code and receipts. Deductions: AIDL files with several top-level declarations or dotted nested forward declarations are mis-identified and silently truncated (R7-02); stale parser caches are not rejected (R7-06); annotation sources whose platform has no imported index map nothing silently (R7-07); unqualified permission literals accepted as proven names (R7-08).

production_catalog_data.rationale: Release005: 37,873/37,873 sources, 772,733 entries, integrity ok, zero schema/FK failures, exact signature reconciliation, entry_kinds sum to bindings, identical counts across native/independent/export reports, 1,384 definitions (core 1,138 unique names), inventory and code hashes pinned. Accuracy deductions: built from a pre-fix snapshot (14 of 26 listed files differ; aidl_members/aidl_lex absent; older 002 DDL), so 12,685 structured AIDL types and 6,681 SDK class nodes are kind 'unsupported' (honest but imprecise), nested AIDL forward declarations mis-identified (R7-02), older AIDL chunker (smoke: +925 member/+417 method occurrences), record constructors mis-signed. Completeness: about 89k AIDL fields/enumerants absent; 235 relevant outside projects with enumerated declared-kind paths (cts 1,813, hardware/sdv/interfaces 403, hardware/google/interfaces 381, development 320) not imported; 744 projects unknown; native/generated Binder unknown. Acknowledgment earns no credit.

overall.rationale: Design, contracts and extractor are near target with two new medium defects (R7-01, R7-02) plus lows, all fixable with fixtures. Overall completeness is bounded by required catalog coverage: release005 is a complete selected corpus built by a superseded extractor and DDL, and the outside corpus remains materially unimported and partly unclassified. Runtime bridge gates are out of scope for this phase and were not scored.

findings.evidence: Second UNION branch: "FROM overlays o CROSS JOIN catalog_view v WHERE o.imported_binding_id IS NULL AND o.state IN ('active','deleted') AND NOT EXISTS(...)"; evidence/original-002 read "o.state='active'". README: "runtime_catalog excludes suppressed/deleted/conflict overlays." schema comment: "They MUST exclude suppressed/deleted/conflict rows for invocation discovery". API-CONTRACT: "Invocation discovery always omits them." test_round5.test_deleted_local_import_collision_blocks_pointer asserts only the pointer IntegrityError; no fixture queries runtime_catalog after a local DELETE.
findings.issue: The F-11 remediation widened the discovery view together with the pointer triggers; a locally deleted entry stays in the invocation-discovery view (ETag state 'deleted'). Discovery grants nothing, but the view violates its own documented contract and is untested.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Change the second branch to o.state='active' in both files(schema.sql and migrations/002) and add a fixture: insert local active overlay plus history, update to state 'deleted' revision 2 plus history, assert SELECT count(*) FROM runtime_catalog = 0 while the tombstone ETag remains readable from overlays for GET 410.
findings.verification_needed: New fixture in test_round5 or test_sealed_registry passing in a fresh regression receipt.

findings.evidence: "d=re.search(r'\b(interface|parcelable|union|enum)\s+([\w]+)',clean)" takes only the first match and \w excludes '.'; "descriptor=(pkg+'.' if pkg else '')+name"; build root record "canonical=d['descriptor'] ... name=d['descriptor'].split('.')[-1]". AOSP frameworks/base (selected corpus) contains forward-declaration files such as android/app/ActivityManager.aidl ("parcelable ActivityManager.RunningTaskInfo; parcelable ActivityManager.RunningServiceInfo; ...") and android/content/pm/PackageInstaller.aidl.
findings.issue: Dotted nested forward declarations are published under the outer type identity (e.g. aidl:android.app.ActivityManager, kind aidl-parcelable) and every declaration after the first in a file is omitted from the inventory; only the generic 'aidl-semantic-gap' issue row (1,721 declaration-only files) exists. This fabricates identity and silently drops declarations, contradicting the no-drop principle; it also affects release005.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: In aidl(), iterate all top-level matches of (interface|parcelable|union|enum)\s+([\w.]+) outside brace bodies, emit one declaration record per match with the dotted descriptor retained, record declaration_count in the parse report; fixture: 'package a; parcelable Outer.Inner; parcelable Other cpp_header "o.h";' expecting roots aidl:a.Outer.Inner and aidl:a.Other.
findings.verification_needed: Fixture passing; count of release005 aidl_schemas.raw_schema rows with more than one declaration or a dotted declaration name.

findings.evidence: "WHEN new.imported_binding_id IS NULL AND new.state='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective_entries e ...)"; runtime_catalog first branch "WHERE o.entry_id IS NULL OR o.state='active'".
findings.issue: A local overlay inserted directly in state 'deleted' for an active imported identity hides that imported entry from discovery without a conflict row (insert-time mirror of F-11).
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Extend both triggers to new.state IN ('active','deleted'); optionally add CHECK((imported_binding_id IS NULL) = (state<>'suppressed')); fixture inserting a local deleted overlay for an effective entry expecting IntegrityError.

findings.evidence: put(): "self.record(key,'update',reason)" for restore and conflict resolution; delete(): "self.record(key,'delete',reason)" for imported suppression; Entry.schema HistoryEvent.operation enum includes 'suppress','restore','rebase'.
findings.issue: Oracle history operations diverge from the contract vocabulary; fixtures assert only history length.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Record 'restore' when prior state was deleted/suppressed, 'rebase' for resolution, 'suppress' for imported delete; assert operation sequence in test_cas_tombstones_history_and_cursor.

findings.evidence: cached_records verifies cache sha256 and record count; "cache_parser_sha256=s['metadata_cache'].get('parser_sha256')" is only folded into the source identity; README: "Source owners must regenerate changed parser caches, never relabel old records."
findings.issue: A rebuild with candidate tooling but stale Java/index caches publishes old-parser records (e.g. without record components) under a new processing fingerprint.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Require metadata_cache.parser_sha256 to equal a declared current parser fingerprint (hash of java_source.py or sdk_api_index.py plus pinned tree-sitter versions) or raise ValueError('Stale parser cache'); fixture with a mismatched hash.

findings.evidence: "if s.get('platform_api_version') is not None: platform=...; current=exact_index_targets.get(platform,{}).get(canonical)"; exact_index_targets is populated only from imported sdk-api-index sources; no issue() emitted and report status stays 'parsed'.
findings.issue: An annotations zip declaring a platform with no imported index yields mapped_annotations=0 silently.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Raise ValueError('No imported SDK API index for annotation platform') or record an issue and status 'partial'; fixture with platform '37.3' and only a '37.2' index.

findings.evidence: "if aidl and '.' not in name:return unknown(...)" applies only to AIDL; validation-report undefined_permission_names includes "MANAGE_MEDIA_PROJECTION" and "QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES".
findings.issue: Unqualified literals (typical of @EnforcePermission in Java sources) become op 'permission' with a name that can never match a manifest definition.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Return unknown('Unqualified permission literal', name) for names without '.' regardless of language, or add 'x-unqualified': true; fixture.
findings.verification_needed: Fixture; undefined_permission_names shrink in the next validation report.
